files_changed_self_report.rationale: Implemented orphan cleanup, signing-key enforcement, request size caps, bounded/cutoff-aware proposal scanning, and corrected banner text for propose().
Added regression coverage for orphaned proposal recovery and adjusted concurrent-branch test doubles to reflect real branch creation state.
Added hardening coverage for missing/current-less signing keys, oversized requests, scan cutoff/cap behavior, and the corrected banner contract.
Documented the stdio PID+path advisory rate-limit caveat and the signing-key-ring failure mode for `SCP-MCP-E021`.
Aligned the 021E plan row with the implemented advisory stdio rate-limit posture and required current signing-key behavior.
Corrected the AC text for the banner wording and clarified the stdio rate-limit caveat in the 021e dispatch package.

self_reported_concerns: The worktree already contained modified dispatch artefacts under `docs/reviews/WP-SCP-022/dispatches/021e/fix-round-1/`; I left those pre-existing changes untouched.

The proposal scan cap is implemented by limiting reads to the newest proposal IDs before sorting by `queued_at`, which is sufficient to bound cost for this slice but still assumes proposal IDs track recency in normal operation.
codex_structured_result.summary: Closed the six 021e MAJ findings within scope. In `tools.py` I added orphaned duplicate recovery under the proposal lock, enforced configured current signing-key discovery with `SCP-MCP-E021` instead of the silent sentinel fallback, bounded `ProposeRequest` title/body sizes, capped proposal scans and short-circuited the rate-limit walk, and corrected the silent-rot banner text. I updated the in-scope error/catalogue and 021E plan/dispatch artefacts to document the stdio rate-limit advisory caveat and the signing-key requirement, and expanded propose() tests to cover orphan recovery, missing/current-less key rings, request size limits, scan bounds, and the corrected banner text. Verification passed with `76 passed` on `python3 -m pytest tests/scp_mcp/ -xvs 2>&1 | tail -20`.
